notes.title: Dev Log #066: Count Down to the Full Release!
notes.notes:
Dear All,

This week marks the final week before the official release of our game. Currently, all the content has been updated, and we are working hard to fix bugs, stabilize the build, and polish performance. 

On this special day, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to every player who has supported us along the way! It is your love and encouragement that give us the courage to get back up after falling and strive continuously, eventually creating our very first game; and itt is your feedback and criticism that enable us to constantly improve and enhance the brilliance of [b]Journey to the West[/b].

We sincerely invite all of you to continue supporting us after the official release on June 29th and spread your passion and love to more friends and favorite streamers! Each share and recommendation holds immense significance to us and serves as the best encouragement!

After the official release on [b]June 29th[/b], we will continue to maintain the game, fix bugs, and provide periodic updates. The development of future DLC is still in the planning stage, so please stay tuned to our channel. As soon as there are any developments, we will notify you promptly!

Thank you once again for your continuous support and stay tuned for future events and updates!

Yours,
ZStudio

notes.title: 2022 Spring Update: Early Access is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[h2]Mark your calendar! [b]Early access[/b] is coming soon on [b]March 10th[/b]![/h2]

The EA version includes 3 heroes (Wukong, White Dragon, and Holy Monk) and 3 chapters of story mode! Stay tuned for more details! ([url=https://discord.gg/ZaSebDg]Our Discord channel[/url] and Official QQ group: 1003867153)

[h1]Major updates[/h1]

[h2]New Skin for Wukong: The Mighty Monkey King![/h2]

We released a new skin for Wukong, which will unlock automatically after beating trial level 0. You can also check it out in the Tutorial:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/40aeff30d8cf54b6834df35e5cbe6775891a7039.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/40aeff30d8cf54b6834df35e5cbe6775891a7039.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]New Hero: Holy Monk[/h2]

We finished the development of a new hero, Holy Monk! As the 10th reincarnation of the Buddha of Life, Holy Monk have some special abilities:
[list]
[*]capture normal or elite NPCs as his Guardians and fight for him in combat
[*]play curse cards to his advantage
[*]apply unique Debuffs [b]Good[/b] and [b]Evil[/b] to enemies and manipulate them accordingly
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f5a135064f860e11521f82b6670efbecda6fdfe1.gif[/img]

[h2]New Title Theme and New UI![/h2]
We upgraded the main title theme, redesigned the UI, and adjusted the team alignment in combat.

[b]New main title and UI[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/130e754146311159e427dadd660e7e39625e1337.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b8366178b96bd5ac40d46b4707161ff67b11944b.jpg[/img]

[b]Improved team alignment in combat: Before vs. After:[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4831f7dc829c7de4c1ef47a7424aaa3ccd6f845a.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4831f7dc829c7de4c1ef47a7424aaa3ccd6f845a.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Challenge Mode[/h2]
We also added a brand new Challenge Mode for each Hero. Each challenge is one combat, with special winning conditions (e.g. a given deck, rescue hostage, or protect teammates).

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4f1c19668c615a4407e8b5e1df5c7d312f7c4000.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4f1c19668c615a4407e8b5e1df5c7d312f7c4000.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Other enhancements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Balanced Wukong, White Dragon, and Companion cards
[*] Balanced relics and consumables
[*] Added credit
[*] Add music and sound effects for Chapter 3
[*] Added more art assets
[*] Rich text enhancement
[*] Polished script and dialog
[*] Improved card flow animation
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

[list]

notes.title: 2021 Winter Update - New Release Date
notes.notes:
[h1]Announcement - Now aiming EA on Q1 2022[/h1]

We updated our early access release date to Q1 2022. Instead of the planned 2 heroes, we are going to release 3 heroes: Wukong, White Dragon, and Holy Monk. Each hero’s story mode includes 3 chapters and 19 levels of trials. We will also release an endless game mode, in parallel with the story mode. We apologize for the inconveniences.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/nd2Xw4MkGh]discord channel[/url] and get the latest update!

[h1]Major updates[/h1]

[h2]New Monkey King Hair System[/h2]
We redesigned the mechanism of Monkey King Hair. Now the new hair card can summon a little monkey to fight alongside Wukong. Each little monkey has 1HP, and will attack once with 3 base damage when Wukong attacks - a nice way to leverage powers or relics that favor multiple attacks or multiple allies. 

Check out the little monkeys in real combat:
[previewyoutube=PXa_HzS5nmU;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Statistics and Achievement[/h2]
Now every playthrough will be recorded and analyzed by the new statistics and achievement system. We will continue to add new achievements as more heroes and game modes are released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/fa6c28fac31d0abc28af145b2fccbd6140a59290.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/d0eefefb81dc6cd12eeca7ff1c17889e1bc06798.png[/img]

[h1]Other enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Balanced Wukong cards
[*]Balanced NPCs
[*]Balanced consumables and relics
[*]Effects improvements
[*]Improved localization
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Fixed various game breaking bugs and logic bugs


[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

The team is working hard on improving the game. Some crucial steps are:
[list]
[*]White Dragon and Holy Monk are being implemented
[*]Adding a brand new interactive tutorial mode
[*]Adding trial level 17-19
[*]Endless mode is in development
[*]Improving UI
[*]Adding more sound effects
[*]Composing music
[/list]

notes.title: JTW Fall Update
notes.notes:
[b]We are honored to be on the Tencent GWB 2021 shortlist! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/nd2Xw4MkGh]discord channel[/url] to learn more![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/434745ed0abdc298d1d8f0530471147dd1b769e1.png[/img]

[h1]Major updates[/h1]

[h2]Trial mode[/h2]

We have added  a trial mode on top of normal story mode. After finishing a normal game, you will be able to enter trial mode. Currently we released 16 trial levels, each adding incremental challenges to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/bf91c0857715d2977e3769b0532f46207aaa076a.png[/img]

[h2]Black market redesign[/h2]
Black Market was redesigned to include entirely new functionality and improved strategic importance during gameplay. Besides purchasing special cards, relics, and consumables, you can also purify spirits, upgrade companions, and purchase talent points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/eacf93decef2b86ff680c9e1597d1a02b43de721.png[/img]

Spirit Purification is an interesting new function. You can purify the spirit of NPCs you’ve encountered and seal it into a bottle of purification. Later you will be able to use it as a helping hand in combat. The consumable “Bottle of Purification” is not required to perform Spirit Purification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4e80716a3c0ec159ead90b6be65af8853f0addce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/ed6cdc3b11096306356be719f982cee8a94f44c1.png[/img]

Purchase Talent Point - now 1 talent point is available each time you enter a black market, starting at 500 gold.

Upgrade Companion is moved from camp to black market.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4d72d6d7bcae51402bdd980ef30d2f2497670542.png[/img]

[h2]In-game compendium[/h2]
We built an in-game compendium so that players can check out full information about cards, relics, consumables, and NPCs anywhere in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/8121ec4a98cc2f1cdc52a37732a1dc6ba0160b16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/ab8c700fe9b0bf532b2af42b5d73ac4a6bd14cc8.png[/img]

[h2]PC graphics improvement[/h2]
[list]
[*]Window mode
[*]Change resolution for optional graphic
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/a8485b75f079a2a82e4a1f0135a2fc7c02f5a860.png[/img]


[h1]Other enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Event scene arts
[*]More art assets
[*]Effects improvement
[*]Elite and boss balance
[*]Balance consumables and relics
[*]Improved localization
[*]UI improvements for mobile version
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

The team is working hard on building, testing and improving the game. Some key next steps are:
[list]
[*]Adding trial mode 17-19
[*]More localization
[*]Continue improving UI
[*]Adding sound effects
[*]Second Hero in development
[*]Working on the music
[/list]

notes.title: New Beta Testing Version Updated
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b8085cea15134c98bba10114fdb8ed0635f38c29.png[/img]

[h3]New beta test version available! Please update to try the latest version, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/nd2Xw4MkGh]discord channel[/url] as beta testers! [/h3]
* Please note that this beta test version is a working in progress build, with some known issues such as uncompleted localization or art assets, and some bugs. We will update the build frequently and improve the testing experience. Thank you for your patience and support!

[h1]Major updates[/h1]

[h2]New Bosses![/h2]
Added 2 new bosses to act 1. We now have 3 sets of bosses in total:
[list] 
[*]Skeleton Queen
[*]Gold Horn and Silver Horn Masters
[*]Spider Queen
[/list]
[previewyoutube=ZsTOxWVl0f0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Build your team![/h2]
The long journey of battling darkness and the finding truth is never a lonely one. On the contrary, the journey becomes exciting and full of surprises with teammates. A companion comes with 2-4 unique cards to add into your deck, and a unique special talent to empower the whole team.
[previewyoutube=Z6GXHmAKATQ;full][/previewyoutube]

You can recruit companions in camp or merchant locations: There are 13 available to hire at the moment. You will also have chances to meet and invite some special companions to join your team in events. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f4afb7d4a62d7332aea9b462c1f6dbc18a480465.png[/img]

[h2]Stealing[/h2]

Now you can use stealing tools (consumable) or certain neutral cards to steal from NPCs: you can get gold, special consumables, relics or cards depending on whom you are stealing from.
[previewyoutube=w6HFVLH9AKw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Status combo[/h2]

Added a status combo system: Now two buffs or debuffs can react to each other and composite into a new status. For example: Burning + Poison = Explosion.
[previewyoutube=cuDTgLe4jNk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Combat dialogs[/h2]
Events and dialogs during combat are now connected. Choices in events and encounters will result in different story lines and dialogs. Moreover, boss events will reveal important information about bosses that might affect the ending.
[previewyoutube=MNZq88aFjy8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Detail window[/h2]
Right click on the hero, companions, or NPCs to get more information (including current intent, status and skill information).

[h2]Wukong card balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shapeshifting - now you can copy the enemy’s intent using a shapeshifting card and the card will return to hand. You can also discharge a copied shapeshifting card during combat so you can copy a new intent.
[*]Meditation - now Wukong can learn skills from all NPCs (if you have at least one shapeshifting cards in the deck) that have been encountered before through the “Meditation” function in Camp.
[*]Hair - most hair related cards will generate hairs based on previous used hair type.
[*]Monkey King Bar  - as the Wukong’s initial relic, the Monkey King Bar will grand an Initial card “high initiative” to change both the length and heaviness.
[*]Evasion - Nimble fighter, sacrifice Constitution for speed and damage
[/list]

[h2]NPC balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Simplified NPC's skill sets and optimized AI
[*]Each group you meet now has their specific strategy, the goal is to make each battle more challenging and fun
[/list]

[h1]Other Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added mini games in some events
[*]Event scene art for most events in act 1
[*]Effects improvement
[*]Camp, merchant, and black market now have attendants
[*]Balancing consumables and relics
[*]Map algorithm improvement
[*]UI Improvements
[*]New mouse cursor
[*]Disable reasons
[*]Card description enhancement
[*]Status and weakness clean-up
[*]Added tutorial
[/list]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

The team is working hard on building, testing and improving the game. Some upcoming key steps are:
[list]
[*]Adding the 2nd playable character
[*]Continue to polish story mode content: Wukong, consumables, relics, encounters and stories for all 3 acts
[*]Adding clear tutorials and key tips to help new players
[*]Adding talent tree
[*]More animations and effects
[/list]

Thank you very much for your support! Please join our discord channel and we will be happy to receive your feedback!
